시편 46:1.content: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

시편 46:2.content: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

시편 46:3.content: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

시편 46:4.content: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

시편 46:5.content: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

시편 46:6.content: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

시편 46:7.content: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

시편 46:8.content: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

시편 46:9.content: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

시편 46:10.content: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

시편 46:11.content: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
